proof_scope: live terraform binary through scaffold->organize->check->deploy(plan gate) on a real temp root, plus typed fail-closed refusals (non-empty scaffold target, messy layout, apply without --yes) and the interview question artifact

claims.proves: the skill scaffolds a valid best-practice layout that real `terraform validate` accepts, audits layout violations deterministically, gates apply behind --yes, and emits typed outcome envelopes
claims.does_not_prove: apply against a real cloud provider/backend, remote state health, or a completed human interview session (needs a live human in the /interview UI)

cases.name: scaffold-validate-live
command: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; W=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf $W' EXIT; ../run.sh scaffold $W/p >/dev/null && ../run.sh check $W/p

cases.name: organize-flags-messy-root
command: W=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf $W' EXIT; echo 'resource "null_resource" "x" {}' > $W/all.tf; touch $W/terraform.tfstate; ../run.sh organize $W; test $? -eq 1

cases.name: apply-without-yes-fails-closed
command: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; W=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf $W' EXIT; ../run.sh scaffold $W/p >/dev/null; cp $W/p/envs/dev.tfvars.example $W/p/envs/dev.tfvars; ../run.sh deploy $W/p --var-file $W/p/envs/dev.tfvars; RC=$?; test $RC -eq 1 && test ! -f $W/p/terraform.tfstate

cases.name: scaffold-refuses-non-empty
command: W=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf $W' EXIT; echo '' > $W/main.tf; ../run.sh scaffold $W; test $? -eq 1

cases.name: interview-artifact-shape
command: W=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf $W' EXIT; ../run.sh interview --out $W/q.json --no-launch >/dev/null && grep -c '"id"' $W/q.json | awk '{ if ($1 >= 5) print "interview_ok"; else exit 1 }'

capability_claims.description: terraform skill validates the OpenAI interview module as a plan-only handoff and preserves apply behind an explicit confirmation gate.
